name: agps-android
description: Capacitor Android wrapper for Anime Game Prompt Studio (runs in LOCAL mode; no API keys are bundled).

scripts.cap:sync: npm run prepare:web && npx cap sync android
scripts.build:debug: npm run cap:sync && cd android && ./gradlew assembleDebug
scripts.build:release: npm run cap:sync && cd android && ./gradlew assembleRelease
scripts.build:aab: npm run cap:sync && cd android && ./gradlew bundleRelease
